meta.query: Compare phases for trials involving nivolumab vs ipilimumab.
meta.interpretation: Compare the distribution of trial phases for trials involving nivolumab versus trials involving ipilimumab.
assumptions: Restricted to interventional studies because observational studies do not have a phase.
Series 'Nivolumab': all 1,816 matching trials were fetched; values are exact.

Series 'Nivolumab': 136 of 1,816 fetched trials matched 'nivolumab' without listing it as an intervention by name, other name, or MeSH term (the registry's intervention search also matches descriptions); they are included. Set drug_match=strict to exclude them.
Series 'Ipilimumab': all 893 matching trials were fetched; values are exact.

Series 'Ipilimumab': 75 of 893 fetched trials matched 'ipilimumab' without listing it as an intervention by name, other name, or MeSH term (the registry's intervention search also matches descriptions); they are included. Set drug_match=strict to exclude them.
comparison_mode=partition: trials were regrouped into 'Nivolumab only' (1,219), 'Ipilimumab only' (296), 'Both' (597) so each trial is counted once.

plan.interpretation: Compare the distribution of trial phases for trials involving nivolumab versus trials involving ipilimumab.
assumptions: Restricted to interventional studies because observational studies do not have a phase.

verification.method: Every row, node, and edge was re-derived from the fetched trial records by a second pass that shares only the field definitions with the aggregation code; every citation was checked for membership in its datum and every cited field value against the record. Registry counts cannot be re-derived locally and are checked for internal consistency instead.
